description:
Local memory and context for you and your AI agent: Markdown notes, documents and tasks on your disk, with an MCP server for GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.

Tisty keeps what you know on your own machine: notes, documents and tasks, in plain
Markdown files you can read without it. Everything you do is written to an append-only
log, so nothing is lost by accident and a change can be walked back; erasing something
for good is the one step that cannot. No account, no
subscription, no telemetry, no server. Sync, if you want it, goes through a folder both
your machines already reach, and an assistant can come in through a door you open.
Agents now shows the folder of each computer as the person sees it, and what another computer keeps stays read-only here.
- This computer's folder carries its name from Sync with «(this computer)» after it. Other computers come last and faint, and two computers with the same name are told apart.
- In another computer's folder, a document has no Edit, Apply here, Delete or pause. Its menu offers only moving, copying as text and taking it out, and the folder's menu offers only Hide.
- A document of one computer opens as an agent's file, with its card, instead of as a plain page.
- Moving a document or a folder between the root, this computer's folder and another computer's folder first asks, saying what changes on this computer and on the others, and nothing moves until you press Move. The window's yes-or-no questions now show the buttons they were given, which also fixes the one for hiding Agents. A folder holding a document with an agent's proposal waiting cannot be moved to another computer, as a document already could not.
- Tisty's skills row in Global shows only where some agent would read them, or where something of theirs is left to turn off.
- An assistant folder at the root of Agents with nothing in it is not shown.
- What an earlier Tisty left goes to each computer's folder once every computer runs 1.50.2, the release that brings this, instead of waiting for 1.51.
- The help, the in-app guide, Privacy, README and LEEME say that each computer keeps its own agent files, that Global keeps only skills, and that Tisty asks which one rules when two clash.
What's Changed
- fix(editor): a title erased or undone waits at its place again, and its hint leaves with the first words by @rgdevment in #991
- fix(agents): the skills' card is short, and a press in a long dialog on a Mac is not rolled away by @rgdevment in #992
- docs(licence): a NOTICE says who made Tisty and what stays, and what an agent is asked to keep by @rgdevment in #993
- feat(mcp): the rules ask an agent to keep author, source and licence of what someone else wrote by @rgdevment in #994
- feat(agents): each computer keeps its own agent files, and a clash with the shared ones asks which rules by @rgdevment in #995
- feat(agents): each computer's folder shows its name, another's is only read, and a move asks first by @rgdevment in #996
- feat(wiring): DeepSeek Harness connects like the others, and the patch shape serves any harness of its kind by @rgdevment in #997
- feat(agents): the skill that writes for the next agent is named next-agent by @rgdevment in #998
Full Changelog: v1.50.1...v1.50.2
